description:
h2. TESTING

The following tests should be performed on the new QA environment

[vC | QA|https://qa.vcreative.net/]

# Login as Demo Prod director
# Click on the Search button 
## Enter client name The Beta Boys
## Select ad type: radio commercial
##  search
## Verify results
### ensure only radio commercial spots are displayed
### ensure only orders for The Beta Boys are displayed
# Click the Search button again from the same view as your previous search
## Confirm the ‘Search Options' are presented and select 'Search Current Folder’
### Verify your previous search’s values are retained
## Refine the previous search to include Status: Active
## Click Search
## Verify in search results that no archived spots are displayed
acceptance_criteria:
1. User can successfully log in as Demo Prod director
2. Search button is accessible and clickable from the main interface
3. User can enter client name 'The Beta Boys' in the search form
4. User can select 'radio commercial' as the ad type filter
5. Search executes and returns filtered results
6. Search results display only radio commercial spots
7. Search results display only orders for 'The Beta Boys' client
8. Search button is accessible from the search results view
9. Search Options dialog presents 'Search Current Folder' option
10. Previous search values (client name and ad type) are retained when reopening search
11. User can refine search to add Status: Active filter
12. Refined search executes successfully
13. Search results do not display any archived spots after adding Active status filter
expected_steps: Given the user is on the QA environment at https://qa.vcreative.net/
When the user logs in as Demo Prod director
Then the user is successfully authenticated and on the main dashboard
When the user clicks the Search button
Then the Search form is displayed
When the user enters 'The Beta Boys' in the client name field
And the user selects 'radio commercial' from the ad type dropdown
And the user clicks the Search button
Then search results are displayed
And only radio commercial spots are shown in the results
And only orders for 'The Beta Boys' are shown in the results
When the user clicks the Search button again from the search results view
Then the Search Options dialog is presented
When the user selects 'Search Current Folder' option
Then the previous search values are retained in the form
And the client name field shows 'The Beta Boys'
And the ad type field shows 'radio commercial'
When the user adds Status: Active filter to the search
And the user clicks the Search button
Then updated search results are displayed
And no archived spots are displayed in the results
And only active radio commercial spots for 'The Beta Boys' are shown

acceptance_criteria:
1. User can open the search panel and filter by client and status criteria
2. User can save a search with multiple filter criteria as a named folder
3. Saved search folder appears in the left navigation with correct name and result count
4. User can click on a saved search folder to view and verify all applied filter criteria
5. User can access folder settings via the cog wheel icon
6. User can share a custom folder with other staff members from a dropdown list
7. Multiple users can be selected for sharing a single folder
8. Shared folder appears in the left navigation of the recipient user after login
9. Recipient user can rearrange, edit, hide, or remove a shared folder without affecting the original owner's folder
10. Changes made to the original folder do not affect shared copies in other users' accounts
11. Custom folders retain all original search criteria (client, status, etc.) when accessed

When the user clicks the search panel button
And the user enters 'They Beta Boys' in the client field
And the user clicks the Search button
Then search results are displayed
When the user clicks 'Save Search as Folder' button
And the user enters 'Beta Boys automation' as the folder name
And the user clicks the Save button
Then the folder 'Beta Boys automation' appears in the left navigation
When the user clicks the cog wheel icon for folder settings
And the user clicks the share icon for the custom folder
Then a dropdown list of available staff members is displayed
When the user selects one or more staff members
And the user clicks the Share button
Then the folder is shared with the selected users
When a recipient user logs in
Then the shared folder 'Beta Boys automation' appears in their left navigation
When the recipient user modifies the shared folder (rearrange, edit, hide, or remove)
Then the original owner's folder remains unchanged
When the original owner modifies the folder criteria
Then the changes do not affect the shared copies in other users' accounts
When the user clicks on the saved folder
Then all original search criteria (client: They Beta Boys, status filters) are displayed and verified

description:
This regression check was created because: If a user manually archives the spot they are getting a toaster. The spot appears to archive manually, however on refresh it reverts to the previous status.

*Preconditions:*

* User has appropriate permissions to update spot status (can choose archived) in the Production Order module abilities
* Spot is in a status eligible for manual archiving
* Spot is visible in either List View or Compact View

----

*Test Steps:*

# Locate a test spot in the appropriate view (List or Compact). TEST BOTH
# Manually change the status to *Archived* using the status dropdown.
# Confirm that the *toaster notification appears*, confirming the action Completed.
# Refresh the page.
# Observe the status of the same spot is sticking in Archived status.
acceptance_criteria:
1. User with appropriate permissions can manually change spot status to Archived from the status dropdown in List View
2. User with appropriate permissions can manually change spot status to Archived from the status dropdown in Compact View
3. A toaster notification appears immediately after changing status to Archived, confirming the action completed
4. After page refresh, the spot status persists as Archived and does not revert to previous status
5. The archived spot remains visible in the view after the status change and refresh
expected_steps: Given a user with appropriate permissions to update spot status in the Production Order module
And a spot is in a status eligible for manual archiving
And the spot is visible in List View
When the user clicks the status dropdown for the spot
And the user selects Archived from the dropdown
Then a toaster notification appears confirming the action completed
And the spot status displays as Archived in the UI
When the user refreshes the page
Then the spot status remains Archived and does not revert to the previous status
Given a user with appropriate permissions to update spot status in the Production Order module
And a spot is in a status eligible for manual archiving
And the spot is visible in Compact View
When the user clicks the status dropdown for the spot
And the user selects Archived from the dropdown
Then a toaster notification appears confirming the action completed
And the spot status displays as Archived in the UI
When the user refreshes the page
Then the spot status remains Archived and does not revert to the previous status
